signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: We're pleased to report the results of our third quarter fiscal year 2026.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: First, for the third quarter 2026, our global insurance unit sales declined 2.7% or 1.9%, excluding the effect of catastrophic volume from a year ago.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: Our U.S. insurance unit volume for the same period declined 4.2% or just over 3%, excluding the effect of those same catastrophic units.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: We believe the long-term growth algorithm for our insurance business remains very much intact, that over many years, we've observed modest gradual declines in accident frequency, which are then more than offset by increases in total loss frequency.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: Total loss frequency is, in turn, a function of ever-rising repair costs, but more importantly, the differentiated returns that Copart generates by finding the highest and best use for a car globally, which is often full restoration back to roadworthiness.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: Claims activity also remains somewhat softer as consumers continue adjusting their insurance purchasing behavior in response to rising premiums.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: As one indicator of this trend from a macro level, earned car years according to ISS Fast Track have declined 4% year-over-year in the fourth calendar quarter of 2025, while vehicles in operation grew 1.4%.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: We believe this divergence, declining insurance coverage against a growing vehicle fleet, is clear evidence of the consumer pullback on insurance coverage.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: When consumers feel pocketbook pressure, especially on a lagged basis regarding their auto insurance rates, they dial back their coverage.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: This softness in claims activity has been partially offset by continued increases in total loss frequency, consistent with the very long-term industry trend.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: We are focused, as always, on delivering superior outcomes for our clients, first and foremost, through auction returns, but also, of course, through our differentiated service offerings from vehicle retrieval to title processing.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: We continue to invest heavily in our technology platforms, our physical infrastructure and our global buyer network to enable those outcomes, representing absolute investment levels that substantially exceed the balance of the industry collectively.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: For example, given recent conflicts, direct participation in U.S. auctions from certain Middle Eastern markets has declined year-over-year.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: Looking back over the past three years, of the more than 30,000 buyers who first entered the Copart ecosystem by virtue of those noninsurance vehicles, a strong majority would bid on an insurance vehicle within the first 90 days of their engagement.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: They know that by virtue of Copart's buyer recruitment, product discovery and auction management practices we will yield the highest and best value the first time through our auction.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: Today, for U.S. insurance sellers at Copart, the mix of pure sale units is at all-time highs.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: We recently completed our 2026 Insurance Advisory Board meeting, a gathering of our largest U.S. insurance clients to discuss current and future catalysts of change in our industry, including artificial intelligence deployment.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: It marks just one visible moment in our ongoing day-to-day engagement with our clients to extend and expand our commercial relationships as we handle ever more of the claims processes for them, including providing them the AI-enabled tools to make front-end total loss decisions more quickly and more accurately through to title procurement, loan settlement and ultimately, auction.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: For the third quarter, consolidated revenue grew to $1.24 billion, up 2.1% year-over-year, driven by strength in both service and purchased vehicle sales.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: During the quarter, we continued to see expansion in average selling prices, which rose 4.6% and more than offset a modest decline in unit volumes of 2.4%.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: On the insurance side, global units were down 2.7%, consistent with the industry dynamics Jeff outlined, while global noninsurance units decreased 1.4%.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Notably, while global inventory was down 2% from the prior year, global assignment volumes grew at a low single-digit pace.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: From a profitability standpoint, the quarter was strong.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Global gross profit increased 3.7% to $572.6 million, with global gross margins increasing 71 basis points to 46.3%.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: During the quarter, we continued to invest across our platform to enhance the products and services we offer to participants across our global marketplace.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: This includes the recent launch of our domestic long-haul delivery services in the U.S.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Operating income grew 2.8% to $464.3 million, net income was $402.4 million, and earnings per diluted share increased 2.4% to $0.43, benefiting in part from our ongoing share repurchase activity.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Total units declined 4.2% or 3.3% excluding Copart Direct units.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Insurance volumes decreased 4.2%, which are consistent with the claims frequency trends Jeff described a few moments ago.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Beyond insurance, we are seeing encouraging momentum across our diversified seller base.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Our Dealer Services and powersports businesses grew units by 1%.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Our BluCar commercial consignment channel expanded by over 4% over the prior year.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Combined fleet and finance seller volume grew at a healthy double-digit pace, which was partially offset by the continued impact of higher repair activity we've seen among our rental customers.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Our Copart Direct unit volume declined 26.3% as we continue to strategically shift lower-value units to our direct buy channel.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: On the inventory side, U.S. inventory is down 4.7% year-over-year, and U.S. assignments declined at a low single-digit pace during the quarter.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Shifting to Purple Wave, our focus on organic territory sales expansion continues to yield strong gross transaction value growth, which was more than 25% for the last 12 months.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: The momentum we are experiencing is being fueled by strong traction in our expansion markets and deepening relationships with select enterprise accounts, which is a real testament to the progress our team is making to scale their platform.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: On revenue, the U.S. segment was essentially flat, down 0.4% as higher revenue per unit largely was offset by volume headwinds.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Insurance ASPs increased 4.1%, noninsurance ASPs increased 3.7% and purchased unit ASPs increased 23%.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: U.S. gross profit grew to $484.1 million, up 0.9%, and gross profit margin was 48.3%.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Internationally, the story is one of continued momentum.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Total units sold increased 5.9% with insurance units up 4.6% and noninsurance units growing 11.2% in the quarter.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Inventory in our international segment increased over 10% from a year-ago period and international assignments increased at a low-teens pace.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: These trends reflect the broad-based growth that we are seeing across our diversified international footprint, with particularly strong contributions from the U.K., Germany and Canada.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: For the quarter, international revenue grew 14.1% or 7.9% excluding the positive impact of foreign currency fluctuations, to $234.2 million.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: The primary source of growth internationally came from service revenues, which were up 17.9%, driven by a 10.5% increase in fee revenue per unit and strong volume growth.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Revenue per unit was positively impacted by strong ASP growth with insurance ASPs increasing 8.4% and noninsurance ASPs growing 16.7%.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: The profit picture was equally compelling, with gross profit increasing 21.9% and operating income reaching $73.8 million, representing a 31.5% operating margin.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Our balance sheet gives us tremendous flexibility to be opportunistic investors throughout business and credit cycles.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: We continue to generate robust free cash flow, which has increased 12% year-to-date, supported by disciplined capital allocation into land, facilities and technology, which positions us to efficiently serve both insurance and noninsurance clients while delivering strong operating efficiency.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: On the capital return front, we continue to repurchase shares during the third quarter through a combination of 10b5-1 and open market transactions.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: Fiscal year-to-date, we have repurchased over 43.4 million shares for an aggregate amount of over $1.6 billion, underscoring our confidence in the future growth prospects for Copart and the long-term value of our business.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: In theory, even if you dramatically reduced new car sales in a given year, that doesn't have a pronounced effect on us given our supply is a layer cake of more than a decade's worth of new car shipments.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: Any one, two or three years of disruption, so long as it doesn't coincide with a dramatic decline in miles driven, would not be the independent variable of greatest consequence.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: You heard me walk through principally the insurance side of the house: the insurance industry has been a strong growth lever for us for decades even on a same-client basis, as accident frequency has historically been more than offset by rising total loss frequency.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: As rising total loss frequency means we sell actual cars rather than baskets of parts, we become the appropriate forum for a growing variety of vehicles, including those from the aforementioned institutions.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: We've expanded globally - most notably since 2007 - and we operate profitably in the U.K., Spain, Germany, Finland, the Middle East, Canada, Brazil, etc.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: International expansion has historically been part of our playbook and will be relevant going forward.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: On catalysts for change, we discussed near-term trends like geopolitical conflict and artificial intelligence.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: We talked at length about AI - how we're deploying it at Copart to support outcomes and how we can support carriers in deploying it.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: Insurance companies are both excited and cautious about AI.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: They must be thoughtful, rigorous, auditable and accountable about new tools.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: AI will be explored across marketing, underwriting, repricing, CRM and claims.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: The U.K. was particularly strong in the quarter, followed by Germany and Canada.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: We've seen strong demand across all three markets on both the insurance side and the noninsurance business.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: We're pleased with our performance there.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: Replenishing that buyer universe is critical, and buyers often start with well-conditioned vehicles and then expand their aperture.

signals.speaker: Jeffrey Liaw
signals.sentence: Buyers gravitate to pure sale items, and you generate better and faster outcomes when buyers are excited to participate.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: The majority of the growth is coming from territory expansion.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: We started with a principally Central Time Zone-focused territory sales force and have expanded out to the coasts.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: The majority of our investment in Purple Wave has been in headcount in that territory sales force as well as focused enterprise-level accounts that are building relationships with large nationwide sellers.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: The GTV growth we are seeing is a result of the success we've had with that territory expansion and the enterprise relationships.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: We're pleased with that.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: The team is about 2.5 to 3 times the size it was when we acquired Purple Wave, and we still have some ways to go to achieve full nationwide coverage, but we have hit the top areas most important for Copart to penetrate and are pleased with the progress.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: We shifted our product offering about 12 months ago and have seen rapid adoption.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: We're pleased with buyer participation in procuring long-haul delivery through the Copart Delivered product.

signals.speaker: Leah Stearns
signals.sentence: We believe it reduces friction and gives buyers cost certainty upfront.
